en.headline: Hiker airlifted after falling ill on Sai Kung trail
en.dek: A man among a group of eight collapsed near Cheung Sheung on MacLehose Trail Section 2; Government Flying Service helicopters lifted him to hospital conscious.
body: A hiker was airlifted to hospital on Tuesday morning after falling ill on a Sai Kung trail under the ongoing very hot weather warning.

At about 9.57am, emergency services received a report that a man in a party of eight had collapsed near Cheung Sheung on Section 2 of the MacLehose Trail. Rescuers attended and the Government Flying Service dispatched a helicopter.
The man was lifted and taken conscious to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital for treatment. No further details of his condition were released.

The Hong Kong Observatory had the Very Hot Weather Warning in force, with temperatures in the New Territories climbing into the mid-30s. Hikers were reminded to carry sufficient water, avoid the hottest hours and watch for signs of heat stress.

zh.headline: 西貢吹筒坳行山客不適 直升機救起送院
zh.dek: 一名男子在麥理浩徑第二段吹筒坳附近與同行七人行山時暈倒，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他清醒送往東區醫院。
body: 一名行山客星期二上午在西貢行山途中不適，由直升機救起送院。
約上午9時57分，當局接報指麥理浩徑第二段吹筒坳附近有八人行山，其中一名男子暈倒。救援人員到場，同時通知政府飛行服務隊派出直升機協助。
事主由直升機救起，清醒送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院治理。當局未有公布其進一步傷勢詳情。
天文台當日繼續發出酷熱天氣警告，新界氣溫升至三十多度。當局提醒市民行山時帶備足夠食水，避免在最熱時段長時間戶外活動，並留意中暑徵兆。
